animations.name: idle_sit
animations.notes: Frame 0 is the canonical neutral pose. Every sitting animation must start from this exact pose.
frame_descriptions: sitting upright facing the camera, calm happy closed-mouth smile, eyes open, ears relaxed, tail curled resting on the ground beside the body
same sitting pose, chest slightly raised (inhale), head about 3% higher, eyes open
same as neutral sitting pose but tail tip flicked upward and one ear slightly twitched
same as neutral sitting pose with eyes half closed (mid blink)
same as neutral sitting pose with eyes fully closed as happy curved arcs (blink)
same as neutral sitting pose, eyes open, head tilted a tiny bit toward the viewer's right

animations.name: look_left
animations.notes: Single-frame head-look pose. look_center is idle_sit frame 0.
frame_descriptions: identical to idle_sit frame 0 (sitting upright facing camera, neutral smile) but head and eyes turned toward viewer's left, pupils shifted toward viewer's left; body, legs and tail unchanged

animations.name: look_right
animations.notes: Single-frame head-look pose. look_center is idle_sit frame 0.
frame_descriptions: identical to idle_sit frame 0 (sitting upright facing camera, neutral smile) but head and eyes turned toward viewer's right, pupils shifted toward viewer's right; body, legs and tail unchanged

animations.name: look_up
animations.notes: Single-frame head-look pose. look_center is idle_sit frame 0.
frame_descriptions: identical to idle_sit frame 0 (sitting upright facing camera, neutral smile) but head and eyes turned toward up, pupils shifted toward up; body, legs and tail unchanged

animations.name: look_down
animations.notes: Single-frame head-look pose. look_center is idle_sit frame 0.
frame_descriptions: identical to idle_sit frame 0 (sitting upright facing camera, neutral smile) but head and eyes turned toward down, pupils shifted toward down; body, legs and tail unchanged

animations.name: stand_idle
frame_descriptions: standing on all four paws, side view facing right, head up, neutral smile, tail up in a soft curve
same standing pose, body 2% lower (exhale), tail tip slightly lower

animations.name: sit_down
frame_descriptions: standing side view facing right, about to sit
hind legs folded, rear lowering toward the ground, front legs straight
sitting upright side view facing right, tail curled behind

animations.name: stand_up
frame_descriptions: sitting upright side view facing right
rear lifting, hind legs unfolding, front legs straight
standing on all four paws side view facing right

animations.name: walk
animations.notes: Side view facing right; left-facing is the mirrored strip. Must loop seamlessly frame 5 -> 0.
frame_descriptions: walk cycle contact pose A: front right paw forward, back left paw back, head level, tail up
walk cycle down pose A: body at lowest point, weight on front right and back left paws, ears bouncing slightly
walk cycle passing pose A: legs passing under body, body at highest point
walk cycle contact pose B: front left paw forward, back right paw back (mirror of A)
walk cycle down pose B: body at lowest point, weight on front left and back right paws
walk cycle passing pose B: legs passing under body, body at highest point

animations.name: run
animations.notes: Loops seamlessly. Body height changes are intentional; preserve motion.
frame_descriptions: gallop extension: all four legs stretched out front and back, body elongated, ears flying back, happy open mouth
gallop transition: legs beginning to gather, body lowering
gallop gather: all four paws tucked under the body, back arched, ears up
gallop transition: front legs reaching forward, hind legs pushing off
gallop airborne: body fully off the ground, legs extended, tail streaming
gallop landing: front paws touching down, body compressing

animations.name: happy
frame_descriptions: sitting upright facing the camera, big open smile with tiny tongue, eyes sparkling, tail wagging to viewer's left
tiny hop: whole body 8% higher off the ground, ears bouncing up, eyes happy arcs
landing squash: body slightly wider and shorter, cheeks puffed, big smile
sitting upright facing the camera, big open smile, tail wagging to viewer's right

animations.name: excited
frame_descriptions: crouched slightly, ready to jump, eyes wide and shiny, big open smile
jumping up, front paws raised, body stretched, ears up
peak of jump, all paws off the ground, huge smile
coming down, paws lowering, ears floating up
landing squash, body wide and short, tongue out
recovering to upright sitting pose, happy wiggle

animations.name: petting
frame_descriptions: sitting upright facing the camera, eyes closed as happy curved arcs, soft blush on cheeks, blissful smile, head pushed slightly upward
same, head tilted toward viewer's left, ears pressed back slightly
same as first frame, body slightly lower and squished (relaxed)
same, head tilted toward viewer's right, ears pressed back slightly

animations.name: kiss
animations.notes: Hearts are NOT drawn by the model; hearts are code-drawn particles.
frame_descriptions: sitting upright facing the camera, neutral smile
leaning forward toward the camera, head slightly larger, eyes closing
maximum lean toward the camera, face large, eyes closed, tiny puckered muzzle or small lick, blush
holding the lean, eyes closed, blush deepening, smile
returning back to sitting, eyes open, happy smile

animations.name: surprised
frame_descriptions: eyes wide with tiny pupils, ears shot straight up, small round open mouth, body jumped 6% off the ground
hold: same wide-eyed expression, body at peak of the hop, all four paws off the ground
landing, still wide-eyed, ears slowly lowering

animations.name: sad
frame_descriptions: sitting, ears drooped down, big glossy eyes looking downward, small frown, tail low on the ground
same, eyes glossier with a tiny highlight, head 2% lower
same as first frame, eyes half-lidded

animations.name: curious
frame_descriptions: sitting upright facing the camera, head tilted toward viewer's right, one ear raised, big attentive eyes
head tilted further, both ears perked, eyes bigger
head tilted back to a slight tilt, held, eyes bright

animations.name: scared
frame_descriptions: crouched low, ears flattened back, eyes wide with tiny pupils, tail tucked between legs
same crouch, body trembling: shifted 2% to viewer's left
same crouch, body trembling: shifted 2% to viewer's right

animations.name: bored_sigh
frame_descriptions: sitting upright facing the camera, cheeks puffed with air
exhaling, cheeks deflating, eyes half-lidded
chin dropped to chest, eyes half-lidded, ears slightly drooped
head slowly returning to neutral, eyes half-lidded

animations.name: bark
frame_descriptions: sitting upright facing the camera, mouth wide open barking, head tilted upward a little, ears up
mouth closing slightly, head snapping forward, body hopping 3%
sitting upright facing the camera, mouth closed proud smile

animations.name: yawn
frame_descriptions: sitting upright facing the camera, neutral, eyes starting to squint
mouth opening wide, eyes squeezed shut, head tilting back
widest yawn, mouth big, tiny tongue curled, eyes shut
mouth closing, eyes watery and half-open
back to neutral sitting, one blink

animations.name: scratch_ear
frame_descriptions: sitting in three-quarter view facing right, neutral
hind leg lifting toward the ear, head tilting into it
hind paw at ear, scratching pose A, eyes closed in relief
hind paw at ear, scratching pose B, ear flopped a bit, eyes closed
hind paw lowering, eyes opening
back to neutral three-quarter sitting, ear fluffed

animations.name: stretch
frame_descriptions: standing side view facing right
play-bow start: front legs reaching forward, chest lowering
full play-bow stretch: chest to the ground, rear up, tail high, eyes closed happily
coming up, front legs walking back
standing side view, small body shake, ears flapping

animations.name: sneeze
frame_descriptions: sitting upright facing the camera, nose scrunching, eyes squinting
head tilting back, mouth opening, eyes squeezed shut
head snapping forward mid-sneeze, mouth open, eyes shut, body pushed back 3%
head shaking, ears flapping, eyes blinking, sheepish smile

animations.name: roll_over
frame_descriptions: sitting upright facing the camera, playful grin
lying down on its side, cute grin
rolling onto back, legs in the air
on its back, paws up, belly visible, tongue out, eyes happy arcs
rolling back to its belly
sitting up again, dizzy happy grin

animations.name: paw_reach
frame_descriptions: sitting upright facing the camera, eyes fixed on something toward viewer's right
right front paw starting to lift toward viewer's right
right front paw fully extended toward viewer's right, tiny toe beans visible
paw retracting, sheepish smile

animations.name: trip
frame_descriptions: running in stride, side view facing right, happy
front paw catches, body pitching forward, eyes wide
belly-flop sliding on the ground, face down, ears flopped forward, comic
sitting up dazed, eyes swirly-simple, head wobbling
shaking head, recovering, embarrassed smile

animations.name: drag
frame_descriptions: picked up by the scruff, body dangling, four legs hanging, surprised cute eyes, ears drooping, tail hanging
same dangling pose, body swung slightly to viewer's right, legs swaying

animations.name: sleep_down
frame_descriptions: sitting three-quarter view facing right, eyelids drooping, sleepy
head nodding down, eyes almost closed
lowering to the ground, front legs sliding forward
curled up lying down, nose tucked toward tail, eyes closed

animations.name: sleep_loop
animations.notes: Zzz letters are code-drawn, not generated.
frame_descriptions: curled up asleep, eyes closed, peaceful smile, body relaxed, nose on paws
same, body slightly inflated (inhale)
same as first frame, one ear twitching
same, body slightly deflated (exhale)

animations.name: wake_up
frame_descriptions: curled up, eyes opening slowly
head lifting, front legs pushing up, sleepy eyes
sitting three-quarter view facing right, small yawn-smile, eyes open

animations.name: dance
frame_descriptions: standing on hind legs, front paws up, leaning left, happy
standing on hind legs, front paws up, upright, tongue out
standing on hind legs, leaning right, happy
hopping, both paws up, ears flying
twirl half turn, tail swishing
landing pose, big smile

animations.name: chase_tail
frame_descriptions: spinning: nose pointing right, tail visible on the left, eyes focused
chasing its own tail, rotation step 1 of 7, body curled toward the tail, eyes locked on the tail
chasing its own tail, rotation step 2 of 7, body curled toward the tail, eyes locked on the tail
chasing its own tail, rotation step 3 of 7, body curled toward the tail, eyes locked on the tail
chasing its own tail, rotation step 4 of 7, body curled toward the tail, eyes locked on the tail
chasing its own tail, rotation step 5 of 7, body curled toward the tail, eyes locked on the tail
chasing its own tail, rotation step 6 of 7, body curled toward the tail, eyes locked on the tail
chasing its own tail, rotation step 7 of 7, body curled toward the tail, eyes locked on the tail

animations.name: tv_watch
frame_descriptions: sitting seen from behind-right, looking toward the right where a TV is, ears up, tail wagging low
same, head tilted slightly
same, ears twitching
same, leaning forward slightly

animations.name: tv_laugh
frame_descriptions: sitting seen from behind-right, mouth visible in profile laughing, shoulders shaking, eyes closed
same, head thrown back slightly
same, bouncing
same, wiping tiny paw at eye

animations.name: hungry
frame_descriptions: sitting upright facing the camera, drooling slightly, big pleading eyes, ears perked
same, tongue licking lips
same, tummy rumble body shift, ears drooping

animations.name: bone_sniff
frame_descriptions: standing side view, nose down sniffing the ground
walking sniffing, nose to the ground
stops, ears perk up
digs with front paws
stands proudly (bone is a separate prop)

animations.name: ball_pounce
frame_descriptions: crouched play-bow, eyes locked forward, rear wiggling
springing forward
airborne pounce, front paws extended
landing, paws down
sitting proudly, tongue out
